items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: I heard some things [Scott] him and Shirley used to do, with the organ group.

ctx.x: "Sugar", and which was a very exciting song. But, uh, and he's always been ah, a blues artist to me because that's all I heard from him, man. You know, I never heard anything else, I heard some things [Scott] him and Shirley used to do, with the organ group. Which was ah, ah musical, but he did things the only to, to ah, make hits. You know, there is a hit, it's two different kinds of things here man, there's a guy who's just concentrating on trying to make a hit record and then a guy who's just trying to express…
So, it's about attitude then, that's what you're saying, too, huh?
